result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 2, Division 38 (construction manager at risk contracts for public works), captured from a code-publisher page that was expected to hold the algorithmic rent-pricing prohibition.
result.notes: This part contains only San Diego Municipal Code sections 22.3801-22.3811 on public works construction manager at risk procurement. It contains no rules on rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The expected San Diego algorithmic rent-setting text (the URL's Division 11, section 98.1103) does not appear in this part, so the list is empty.
